recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Do not re-add ARQ-7/SCH-7 to Appointment.appointmentType for FHIR-8843 because FHIR-41607 is a later final PA decision; revisit only if PA reopens the broader V2 Appointment field alignment.
issue_request: FHIR-8843 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for DSTU2 asking to correct Appointment HL7 V2 mappings: ARQ-11.2 should not map directly to Appointment.end, ARQ-11 should feed requestedPeriod, ARQ-7 should not remain on Appointment.reason and was then directed to appointmentType, and requestedPeriod needed an RIM mapping.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git commit 0d8362807391a5d3c760d94582a8087e19adad6a against the historical Appointment spreadsheet source. That commit removed ARQ-11.2 from Appointment.end, added ARQ-11 and a RIM mapping to Appointment.requestedPeriod, and moved ARQ-7 off Appointment.reason. The active source is now source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml, with Appointment active in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-7875 and FHIR-13861 are the same Appointment reason/type V2 mapping family. FHIR-13861 later aligned ARQ-7/SCH-7 to Appointment.appointmentType and ARQ-8/SCH-8 to Appointment.serviceType. FHIR-41607, an Applied R6 PA decision, subsequently removed the core Appointment.appointmentType V2 mapping and mapped ARQ-7/SCH-7 with Appointment.serviceType because the relevant V2 fields are user tables and the core mapping breadcrumb was confusing. A later QA RIM mapping commit also normalized requestedPeriod from ActAppointmentRequest.effectiveTime to the current relative .activityTime mapping, which is present in published R4 and R5 Appointment profiles.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source maps Appointment.end without ARQ-11.2, maps Appointment.requestedPeriod to ARQ-11, maps Appointment.reason only to AIS-3, and maps ARQ-7/SCH-7 under Appointment.serviceType per FHIR-41607.

Applied R6 issue intentionally removed the Appointment.appointmentType V2 mapping and placed ARQ-7/SCH-7 with Appointment.serviceType.
